scheme_name: Merit cum Means Scholarship: Engineering University
other_conditions: Must have passed the 10+2 (or equivalent) examination with at least 45% marks.
Must be a native resident of Chhattisgarh.
Must be currently studying in a recognised engineering university in Chhattisgarh or an AICTE‑approved institution outside the state for BE/BTech courses.
Father’s/guardian’s total annual income must not exceed ₹2,50,000.
Students in full‑time employment are not eligible.
Children of permanent government employees of Chhattisgarh deputed to the Government of India or another state are exempted from the domicile condition.
No student may receive more than one scholarship at the same time, except fee concessions.
Part‑time work is allowed only if the student is already receiving another scholarship.
Special scholarships may be granted based on poverty and merit in exceptional cases.
documents_required: Copies of all mandatory documents (self‑attested, if required)
